title: Working with data safely
description: Illustrative three-module course showing progress tracking and quizzes.
intro: Illustrative content. Three short modules, one quiz each. Your progress is saved in this browser only, and the course works without it.
footer: Illustrative example generated with blend-guide. Not real training material.

blocks.p: Before any analysis, classify the data: public, internal, or restricted. The class decides where it may live and who may see it.

callout.title: Rule of thumb
callout.text: When in doubt, treat the data as restricted until someone confirms otherwise.

quiz.q: A file has no label. What do you do first?
options: Treat it as restricted and ask its owner
quiz.why: Unlabelled data is restricted until the owner confirms its class.

blocks.p: Work in approved locations only. Keep secrets out of notebooks and commits.

options: In a secrets manager or an ignored env file
quiz.why: Secrets stay out of anything that is versioned or shared.

blocks.p: Before sending results outside the team, check for personal data, small cell counts and client names.

list: Ask for a second pair of eyes

quiz.q: Which output is safest to share?
options: An aggregate with no small groups
quiz.why: Aggregates without small groups avoid re-identification.
